codedValues.name: Cooling Center - Offering a place indoors to cool down.
Hydration Station - Offering bottled water only.
Respite Center - Offering a place indoors to cool down and allows for uninterrupted rest.
General Collection - Only accepting snacks and sun protection items like sun screen, sun glasses, and hats.
Water Collection - Only accepting bottled water donations.
Water & General Collection - Accepting bottled water and general collection donations.
Hours differ **use OUTSIDE OF extreme heat warning**
Hours differ ** use DURING extreme heat warning**
